noModel.title: Connect a model on {{name}}
noModel.body: Sign in to ChatGPT or enter an API key in this environment's console. Keys and logins stay on {{name}}.

setup.title: Choose where Her runs
setup.sub: Her works on the machine you choose: its conversations, memory and files stay there, and it answers while that machine is on.
setup.thisMacDesc: Her goes offline while this Mac sleeps
setup.newServerDesc: Install Hermesh on it and pair it, as Add Machine does
setup.signer: Confirm in the signer to turn on Her on {{name}}.

chat.greeting: Hi, I'm {{name}}. I work on {{environment}}. Tell me what you need, several things at once if you like.
chat.unread: This conversation is kept on {{name}}. It shows once the machine is back.
chat.queued: Delivered once it finishes this reply

waiting.noPictures: Pictures go once {{name}} is back. Attach them as files, or send them then.

composer.label: Message
composer.dropTitle: Drop to add to the chat

model.thinkingChanged: {{model}} has no “{{from}}” level; thinking is now “{{to}}”

sheet.tooLarge: The image is too large: 10 MB at most

access.title: Give “{{name}}” full access?
access.body: It acts on {{environment}} without asking you, and so do the agents and scheduled tasks it starts. Her reads web pages and messages from anyone, so turn this on only if you trust everything on that machine to it.
access.signer: Confirm in the signer to give {{name}} full access on {{environment}}.

clear.title: Clear your chat with “{{name}}”?
clear.message: The chat history is cleared and the work it is doing stops. Its files, scheduled tasks and settings stay.

panel.modelNote: Models and keys are added in the environment’s console.
panel.permissionNote: {{desc}}. The agents and scheduled tasks Her starts run with it too, while you are away as well. Full access is confirmed with Touch ID.
panel.mutedNote: No notifications from it, on any device. Unread still shows in the list.
panel.permissionNote_win: {{desc}}. The agents and scheduled tasks Her starts run with it too, while you are away as well. Full access is confirmed with Windows Hello.

approval.label: Waiting for your approval
approval.sessionDesc: Calls like this one won't ask again in this conversation
approval.sessionRule: Commands starting with “{{rule}}” won't ask again in this conversation
approval.siteAlwaysDesc: Browsing and acting on this site won't ask again; kept in this environment
approval.siteEveryDesc: Browsing and acting on any public site won't ask again (private network addresses still do); kept in this environment. Risk: a page with injected instructions could get Her to act on sites it is signed in to.
approval.grantScript: Allow Scripts on This Site for This Conversation
approval.grantScriptDesc: Scripts on {{site}} won't ask again in this conversation
approval.grantAppDesc: Won't ask again for this app in this conversation
approval.feedback: Tell Her why, or what to do instead (optional)
approval.rememberDesc: Also keep this permission in the environment's settings, so later conversations don't ask

fail.auth: {{provider}} isn't signed in on this environment

failure.auth: Not signed in to the provider

advice.auth: Sign in again or enter another key in the console, then retry.
advice.quota_exceeded: Top up the provider's account or switch models, then retry.
advice.rate_limited: The provider asks to slow down. Retry in a moment.
advice.overloaded: The provider is busy. Retry in a moment.
advice.server: The provider had a problem. Retry in a moment.
advice.network: The environment can't reach the provider. Retry in a moment.
advice.timeout: The provider took too long. Retry, or switch models.
advice.context_overflow: Compact the context, or clear the chat in the assistant's settings.
advice.content_filtered: Rephrase the request, or switch models.
advice.unknown: Retry, or look at the details.
advice.no_reply: The model ended its turn without sending you anything. Retry, or try another model.

manual.title: Ask Permissions
manual.desc: Asks before changing files or running commands

accept-edits.title: Accept Edits
accept-edits.desc: Changes files in its folder without asking; asks before commands

bypass-permissions.title: Full Access
bypass-permissions.desc: Runs everything without asking, except deny rules, ask rules and deleting critical paths

steps.thinkingHidden: The provider keeps this reasoning private

routines.title: Scheduled Tasks
routines.newDraft: Set up a scheduled task for me:
routines.note: Scheduled tasks run on {{name}}. They don't run while it is off or asleep, and catch up once, with the latest, when it is back.

empty.title: No scheduled tasks yet
empty.body: Just tell {{name}}, for example “give me a pre-market brief every morning at 8”.

routines.runNowNote: Run Now really does the task.

result.skippedWhy: The run before it was still going
